title: HelperSessionLifecycleCompleteParams
description: One already-authenticated completion, carried DOWN by the coordinator to the session that owns the pane (owner decision 2026-09-19). The coordinator's kernel has validated protocol version, domain liveness, transport binding, epoch, capability and the sequence rule -- authentication does not move -- and this op is the carrier of the fact, not a second gate on it: the helper resolves the session, decodes the fence, and hands all three to the session runtime, whose own incarnation check is the only judging this side of the wire does.

incarnation.description: The session runtime's own identity: the session the PTY belongs to and which generation of it is live. Deliberately NOT the outer session object, whose generation is the content-addressed helper INSTALL id (a string): one field is an install name, the other a numeric per-PTY generation. The sender derives it from facts with named owners: the session half from the spawn entry, the generation from the helper's stated level-1 invariant (one runtime per PTY, at generation 1 -- newSessionRuntime's own doc, pinned by TestTheRuntimeIncarnationIsTheSessionAtGenerationOne). A sender whose derivation is stale is refused by the runtime rather than applied late.

nonce.description: The kernel's render fence for the completed execution: exactly 64 lowercase hex characters, the same fixed-width spelling the launch's bearer values use. The rendezvous matches on it exactly; a decoder that truncated or tolerated another spelling would hand the runtime a rendezvous nothing sighted.

exitCode.description: The exit status the kernel recorded, and null when the shell named none. Null is an ANSWER and is always present rather than omitted: the kernel recorded no exit code, and this generation does say so.
